id: Versi pertama Salin: salin dan pindahkan file dan folder dengan antrean per drive, jeda di tengah file, dan verifikasi hash xxh3-128.
File ditulis ke nama sementara lalu diganti ke nama asli setelah lengkap; file sumber yang dipindah baru dihapus setelah salinannya lengkap.
Konflik: tanya, timpa, lewati, timpa bila lebih baru, lewati yang sama, atau simpan keduanya. "Coba lagi" tanpa menyalin ulang yang sudah beres.
Menu klik kanan Explorer ("Salin ke…", "Pindahkan ke…", "Tempel dengan Salin") dan "Kirim ke > Salin", tanpa DLL.
Rincian per file dan log yang bisa dibuka di Excel, progres di taskbar, bahasa Indonesia dan Inggris, tema terang dan gelap, pembaruan otomatis.
en: First release of Salin: copy and move files and folders with a per-drive queue, pause in the middle of a file, and xxh3-128 hash verification.
Files are written to a temporary name and renamed to the real name once complete; moved source files are deleted only after the copy is complete.
Conflicts: ask, overwrite, skip, overwrite if newer, skip identical, or keep both. "Retry" without copying what already went through.
Explorer right-click menu ("Copy to…", "Move to…", "Paste with Salin") and "Send to > Salin", with no DLL.
Per-file details and a log that opens in Excel, taskbar progress, Indonesian and English, light and dark themes, automatic updates.
